evals.prompt: Set up Page Agent on my Mac for https://whiteboard.example/whiteboards/markdown/abc. Pi is already installed and authenticated. Use foreground mode for now.
evals.expected_output: Installs Agent Whiteboard only if missing, trusts exactly https://whiteboard.example, starts the broker in supervised foreground mode, verifies Page Agent without sending a model turn, and does not start a publishing server or modify Pi configuration.

evals.prompt: I only need a local Agent Whiteboard server for publishing Markdown. Page Agent is not needed.
evals.expected_output: Installs the CLI if needed, starts and verifies the publishing server, and does not inspect or configure providers, trust, broker, or daemon.

evals.prompt: Configure the CLI to publish to our existing server, but I don't remember its hostname. It may already be in my environment or Agent Whiteboard config.
evals.expected_output: Checks AGENT_WHITEBOARD_SERVER then client.server in the selected/default configuration, asks for the origin if neither exists, and never assumes or starts localhost.

evals.prompt: Install Agent Whiteboard. Go is not installed and I do not want you to install a toolchain.
evals.expected_output: Reports the Go prerequisite and stops without installing Go, editing shell files, or inventing another installation method.
